title: conversationHistoryUpdate payload
description: The DataPart 'data' object the Live layer MAY send in a ROLE_USER message to backfill a locally handled turn or an interrupted response (spec §8). The Live layer is authoritative for what the caller actually heard.

messages.description: The messages exchanged during the backfilled turn.

played_text.description: For a truncated response, the portion actually played.

unspoken_text.description: For a truncated response, the portion not played.

source.description: Origin of the backfilled turn (e.g. locally handled, interrupted).
